limitations: The 32-bit limb framing and 16-bit final tail are a bounded representation hypothesis, not a recovered historical wrapper.

A fixed Rev3-board output or language score cannot exclude an unknown symbol assignment.
No Rev7 bytes are read or evaluated by these controls.
model: fixed-width independent unsigned limbs -> ordinary two-header straddling checkerboard
